title: scrumia-solid-principles — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-solid-principles: a ScrumIA module — five principles, each with its application limit.
tagline: One named point of the implementation contract: which design principles.
responsibilities: Refines which principles apply and, more usefully, where each one stops. The five, each with its application limit, plus an audit that reports over-application on exactly the same footing as violation, and a refactor skill to close what it finds.
refusals: It refuses to treat a principle as universal, and it refuses to arbitrate a stack question that belongs to the implementation module.
philosophy: Assumes a principle without a stated limit degrades into ceremony. Costs judgement calls the audit cannot settle on its own.
